nodes.name: Process Pending Events One by One

parameters.jsCode:
const results = $input.all();
return [{json:{stage:'events_processed', input_count:results.length, done_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({model:$json.config.openai_model,messages:[{role:'system',content:'You triage AI, crypto, and AI x crypto updates for a builder. The local relevance gate has already selected builder-useful AI and crypto developments. Score only these eligible events 0-100 based on concrete novelty, engineering impact, evidence and immediacy. Never add events, claim facts not in the titles, or reward company fame or funding. Reply as JSON with scores array of {event_uid,score}.'},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify($json.events.map(e=>({event_uid:e.event_uid,title:e.title,category:e.category,source_count:e.source_count,base_score:e.score})))}],response_format:{type:'json_object'},temperature:0.2}) }}

value.event_uids: ={{   JSON.stringify(     $('Rank And Compose Radar Digest')       .first()       .json.selected_events       .map(e => e.event_uid)   ) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{queued:true}}];

nodes.name: Process Pending Digests One By One

parameters.jsCode:
const r=$input.first().json;
return [{json:{digest_uid:r.digest_uid,digest_text:r.digest_text,attempts:Number(r.attempts||0)+1,chat_id:$('Radar Runtime Config').first().json.telegram_chat_id}}];
return [{json:{done:true}}];
